subject: Matt Webster responds to Road Rules Achievements
author: ZombieTron
body:
Taken from EA forums:
You've nailed it! We've noticed that if you attempt this achievement after you have been online and the game has downloaded a friends score then it's this score that you need to beat. We're looking to address this in the future, but there is a workaround. Either you beat your friends time, or you remove them, beat it and then re-add them. This may also be apparent on the Showtime achievement as well. As I said, we're looking in to it now.

-Mat
